purpose: Shared node/edge contract for LOC context Graph. Context owns relation/context semantics; Search/Analysis implements bounded Graph traversal and retrieval; Evolution consumes governed graph projections for time/ERA/literary-evolution views. LOC1–8 labels are historical/provenance only.
current_architecture: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition

compatibility.owned_by_loc: Legacy edge name retained for existing data compatibility. It represents recorded source/domain provenance only and must not be interpreted as Current LOC1–8 architecture ownership.
compatibility.loc_number_policy: LOC1–8 references may remain in historical node metadata and source identifiers, but never create Current Scope, Feature or Canon authority.

rules: Graph nodes are references to authoritative records, not replacement copies.
Canonical edges require explicit registry evidence, authoritative metadata, or deterministic structural evidence.
Semantic similarity may select seed nodes but must never create a canonical edge by itself.
ERA-P0 through current ERA form a deterministic temporal backbone from LOC_ERA_REGISTRY where that registry is the applicable Scope authority.

Search-time result nodes may receive transient owned_by_loc, belongs_to_era, and media/work linkage edges from their own recorded metadata; owned_by_loc is a compatibility/provenance field, not Current LOC-number ownership.
Graph traversal is bounded and feeds Search synthesis with Scope/domain paths, ERA paths, works, media and analysis nodes.
Context owns graph relation/context semantics; Search/Analysis manages traversal and retrieval algorithms; Evolution consumes governed graph projections for temporal views.
Repository snapshots may contribute public temporal/event observation nodes without replacing a live private authority source.
Private source rows are never exposed through public Search unless they are explicitly governed into a public registry/snapshot.
Search responses expose a provenance envelope summarizing source_refs and graph evidence kinds/status.
Every traversable edge carries edge_quality and quality_band derived from relation type, evidence kind and evidence status.
Traversal priority is quality-weighted and decays by hop; paths below min_traversal_score are not expanded.
owned_by_loc and belongs_to_era are directional structural projections and must not be used as reverse-discovery hubs.
Named/historical entity queries may use exclusive canonical seeds; abstract concept queries retain cross-Scope retrieval breadth.
Public Graph access is metadata-only by default; graph payload requires a bounded center or query-driven Search result.

search_synthesis.seed_source: precision-aware Unified Search results + canonical exact entity matches

provenance.public_relation_policy: Only governed public relation/context snapshots are exposed. Context owns relation semantics; private source rows remain private until explicitly published.

quality_policy.model: edge_quality = evidence_weight × status_weight × relation_weight; traversal_score = parent_path_score × edge_quality × hop_decay^(hop-1)

rules: GET /search/graph without node_id returns counts/type metadata only and never the canonical node/edge payload.
Actual graph payload is exposed only through bounded neighborhood lookup or query-driven Search Graph results.
Graph View consumes the public bounded projection; it does not become the canonical graph authority.
Live private relation rows remain outside public Graph unless explicitly governed into a public registry/snapshot.
